tasks.label: Format
tasks.command: & .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff format .; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; & .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m ruff check --fix .

tasks.label: Reload QSpice MCP
tasks.command: $mcp = Get-Content -Raw '.\.cursor\mcp.json' | ConvertFrom-Json; $mcp.mcpServers.qspice | Add-Member -NotePropertyName devReloadStamp -NotePropertyValue ((Get-Date).ToString('o')) -Force; $mcp | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -Path '.\.cursor\mcp.json' -Encoding UTF8; Write-Host 'Bumped .cursor/mcp.json devReloadStamp — toggle qspice MCP in Settings if it does not reload automatically.'
